first-note.title: start with the essential details.
first-note.body: Your first email can include the details that help frame your wedding:

closing.title: every story begins with a conversation.
closing.body: Tell me where you are coming from, when and where you are getting married, and what you hope to feel on the day. I would love to hear from you.

items.title: Who is The Bridal Narrative for?
items.content: International brides planning a destination wedding in Mexico who want a calm, authentic and deeply personal experience.

items.title: Is communication available in English?
items.content: Yes. All Bridal Narrative communication is in English.

items.title: What should I include in my first email?
items.content: Your name, country of origin, event date and event location.

items.title: How is the hairstyle considered?
items.content: Through your hair type, texture, length, the climate, event duration and your specific needs.

items.title: Do you reproduce a hairstyle from a photograph?
items.content: The aim is not to reproduce a photograph, but to create something that makes sense for the person who will wear it.

items.title: Can hairstyle duration be guaranteed?
items.content: Professional products and techniques are used to offer the greatest possible duration, but humidity, wind, rain and event activities can influence the final result.

items.title: How are deposits, date changes, cancellations and travel handled?
items.content: Deposits, advance payments, date changes, cancellations, travel, schedules and related expenses are defined in the service agreement for each wedding.

items.title: Does sending an email confirm my booking?
items.content: No. The email begins the inquiry. No booking or payment is completed through this page.
